# Forge Web

> Free browser-based Magic: The Gathering playtesting against AI.

Forge Web provides a browser interface over the Card-Forge rules engine.
Watch live AI games without signing in. Sign in with an email code to import,
edit and save decks, then play against AI. Standard and Commander are the
current constructed-play focus. Imports resolve card names against the pinned
Forge catalog. Catalog availability does not guarantee browser gameplay support.

## Public pages

- [Live table](https://forgeweb.app/): Watch AI games and start playing.
- [About](https://forgeweb.app/about): Project background and contact form.
- [More information](https://forgeweb.app/llms-full.txt): Current scope and account requirements.

## Current limits

- Draft, sealed and the general puzzle browser are parked.
- Desktop is the best experience. Mobile layouts and board interaction need refinement.
- Play is against AI; human multiplayer is not currently offered.
- The browser displays the game. A server runs the rules engine.
- Forge Web is not affiliated with or endorsed by Wizards of the Coast.

## Engine

- [Card-Forge](https://github.com/Card-Forge/forge): The upstream rules engine, not the Forge Web application repository.
